items.title: 56800_John Simmons oral history interview
items.q: Boy, you talk about Jesse Owens! They ran us all through town!

ctx.x: Well, this passenger train just started oozing off slowly. They didn't give a highball. So my partner and I

jumped out from behind these railroad ties, and we're running down the side, trying to get up to the blind, and the railroad dick had one of these big knob flashlights, they threw it at our heels, and we say "Oh, damn," we turned to our left, getting away from the train, and he turned the flashlight up and seen our complexion. Boy, you talk about Jesse Owens! They ran us all through town!
